Klasse FiniteStateMachine<S,IA,OA>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.automata.FiniteStateMachine<S,IA,OA>
Typparameter:
S - the type of states
IA - the type of input symbols (Input Alphabet)
OA - the type of output symbols (Output Alphabet)
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
StateMachine<S,IA,OA>
@Mutable @ThreadSafe public class FiniteStateMachine<S,IA,OA> extends Object implements StateMachine<S,IA,OA>

A thread-safe implementation of a finite state machine (FSM) that supports both Moore and Mealy machine semantics.

This implementation maintains a current state and transitions between states based on input symbols, producing output symbols according to the configured output function. All state transitions are protected by a reentrant lock, making this class safe for concurrent use.

Instances should be created using the static factory methods mooreMachine(Set, Set, Set, Fun2, Fun, Set, S) or mealyMachine(Set, Set, Set, Fun2, Fun2, Set, S) rather than the constructor directly.

Seit:
1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • mooreMachine

      public static <S,IA,OA> FiniteStateMachine<S,IA,OA> mooreMachine(@NonNull Set<S> states, @NonNull Set<IA> inputAlphabet, @NonNull Set<OA> outputAlphabet, @NonNull org.quurz.foomp.base.functions.Fun2<S,IA,S> transitionFunction, @NonNull org.quurz.foomp.base.functions.Fun<S,OA> outputFunction, @NonNull Set<S> endStates, @NonNull S initialState)

      Creates a Moore machine, where outputs depend only on the current state.

      In a Moore machine, the output is determined solely by the current state, independent of the input that triggered the transition. The provided outputFunction receives only the state as input.

      Typparameter:
      S - the type of states
      IA - the type of input symbols
      OA - the type of output symbols
      Parameter:
      states - the set of all possible states; must not be null or empty, and must not contain null elements
      inputAlphabet - the set of all valid input symbols; must not be null or empty, and must not contain null elements
      outputAlphabet - the set of all valid output symbols; must not be null or empty, and must not contain null elements
      transitionFunction - the function mapping (state, input) to next state; must not be null and must not return null
      outputFunction - the function mapping state to output; must not be null and must not return null
      endStates - the set of accepting/final states; must be a subset of states; must not be null (but may be empty)
      initialState - the initial state; must not be null and must be contained in states
      Gibt zurück:
      a new Moore machine instance
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any parameter is null, or if any set contains null elements
      IllegalArgumentException - if any set is empty, if endStates is not a subset of states, or if initialState is not in states
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • mealyMachine

      public static <S,IA,OA> FiniteStateMachine<S,IA,OA> mealyMachine(@NonNull Set<S> states, @NonNull Set<IA> inputAlphabet, @NonNull Set<OA> outputAlphabet, @NonNull org.quurz.foomp.base.functions.Fun2<S,IA,S> transitionFunction, @NonNull org.quurz.foomp.base.functions.Fun2<S,IA,OA> outputFunction, @NonNull Set<S> endStates, @NonNull S initialState)

      Creates a Mealy machine, where outputs depend on both the current state and the input.

      In a Mealy machine, the output is determined by both the current state and the input that triggers the transition. The provided outputFunction receives both the state and the input symbol.

      Typparameter:
      S - the type of states
      IA - the type of input symbols
      OA - the type of output symbols
      Parameter:
      states - the set of all possible states; must not be null or empty, and must not contain null elements
      inputAlphabet - the set of all valid input symbols; must not be null or empty, and must not contain null elements
      outputAlphabet - the set of all valid output symbols; must not be null or empty, and must not contain null elements
      transitionFunction - the function mapping (state, input) to next state; must not be null and must not return null
      outputFunction - the function mapping (state, input) to output; must not be null and must not return null
      endStates - the set of accepting/final states; must be a subset of states; must not be null (but may be empty)
      initialState - the initial state; must not be null and must be contained in states
      Gibt zurück:
      a new Mealy machine instance
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any parameter is null, or if any set contains null elements
      IllegalArgumentException - if any set is empty, if endStates is not a subset of states, or if initialState is not in states
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • read

      public @NonNull OA read(@NonNull IA input)

      Performs a state transition for the given input symbol and returns the associated output.

      This method is thread-safe. It computes the output based on the current state (and optionally the input, depending on machine type), then transitions to the next state as determined by the transition function.

      The entire read-transition-output cycle is executed atomically under a lock.

      Angegeben von:
      read in Schnittstelle StateMachine<S,IA,OA>
      Parameter:
      input - the input symbol to process; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the output symbol associated with this transition
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if input is null, or if the transition or output function returns null
      IllegalArgumentException - if input is not in the input alphabet, if the transition function returns a state not in the state set, or if the output function returns an output not in the output alphabet
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • reset

      public @NonNull FiniteStateMachine<S,IA,OA> reset()

      Resets the state machine to its initial state.

      This method is thread-safe and can be called at any time. After calling this method, the machine behaves as if it was just constructed, with all state history cleared.

      This method supports fluent-style method chaining.

      Gibt zurück:
      this instance for method chaining
      Seit:
